test_title: PYST 07: SSC JE EE - General Intelligence (Held on 05 Jun 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
L, M, N, O, P, Q, and R are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. L sits second to the right of M. N sits third to the right of L. O sits second to the left of N. P is not an immediate neighbour of N. Q sits to the immediate right of O.

How many people are sitting between L and R when counted from the left of L?
solution: According to the given information, 1) L sits second to the right of M. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d90b5104633ae927d6eedc3174f4e8bdbee3f226a17199073d80c9e77046fd1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06f6183aa4983f2c6d8f814c80b90a5b397dc1bd4eea09794d5ac265b80a522d.png] 2) N sits third to the right of L. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fa8a1e5e00f98bad864f5e833a073cfc24bdde7a289985c9eca4f15aebb0ef7.png]
